<td class="text"><p id="xdx_807_eus-gaap--CompensationAndEmployeeBenefitPlansTextBlock_zX03Lk8nk6ed" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>NOTE 8: <span id="xdx_822_znwN7tEJCL54">EMPLOYEE STOCK INCENTIVE PLAN</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In May 2016, the Company implemented the 2016
Employee Stock Incentive Plan (the &#8220;Plan&#8221;) for employees and reserved 818,181 shares of Class A Voting Common Stock for issuance
under the Plan. The Company&#8217;s Board of Directors amended the stock option Plan to reduce the number of authorized options from <span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance_c20160531__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--N2016EmployeeStockIncentivePlanMember_pd" title="Shares reserved for future issuance">818,181</span>
to <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance_c20201202__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--N2016EmployeeStockIncentivePlanMember_pd" title="Shares reserved for future issuance">733,424</span> per the terms of the December 2, 2020, stock purchase and exchange agreement. As of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, there
remains <span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant_c20260630__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--N2016EmployeeStockIncentivePlanMember_pd" title="Shares available">135,924</span> and <span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant_c20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--N2016EmployeeStockIncentivePlanMember_pd" title="Shares available">175,924</span> shares, respectively, available for issuance under the Plan.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The following table is the summary of stock
option activities for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and the year ended December 31, 2025:&#160;</p>

<p id="xdx_8AE_z5S9LLK72Zde" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company uses the Black-Scholes option-pricing
model to estimate the grant date fair value of stock options, which requires the use of assumptions, including the expected term of the
option, expected volatility of its stock price, and the risk-free interest rate, among others. These assumptions reflect best estimates,
however; they involve inherent uncertainties including market conditions and employee behavior that are generally outside of the Company&#8217;s
control. Generally, once stock option values are determined, accounting practices do not permit them to be changed, even if the estimates
used are different from actual results. All stock-based compensation is expensed when awarded to employees based on the grant date fair
value of the awards over the requisite service period, adjusted for forfeitures. Stock-based compensation expense was $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensation_c20260401__20260630_pp0p" title="Stock-based compensation expense">51,151</span> and $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensation_c20260101__20260630_pp0p" title="Stock-based compensation expense">91,197</span>
for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, respectively, and $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensation_c20250401__20250630_pp0p" title="Stock-based compensation expense">0</span> and $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--EmployeeBenefitsAndShareBasedCompensation_c20250101__20250630_pp0p" title="Stock-based compensation expense">20,974</span> for the three and six months ended June 30, 2025, respectively.
The intrinsic value of the options outstanding as of June 30, 2026, was $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsOutstandingIntrinsicValue_c20260630_pp0p" title="Intrinsic value of options outstanding">2,743</span> with an unamortized compensation expense of $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognized_iI_pp0d_c20260630_z793whC6wNH5" title="Unamortized compensation expense">450,780</span> to
be recorded over the next five years.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Key data inputs (estimates or assumptions) used

    <td style="border-bottom: Black 2.5pt double; text-align: left">$</td><td style="border-bottom: Black 2.5pt double; text-align: right"><span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensation_c20250401__20250630_pp0p" title="Stock-based compensation expense"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden: xdx2ixbrl1620">&#8212;</span></span></td><td style="padding-bottom: 2.5pt; text-align: left">&#160;</td><td style="padding-bottom: 2.5pt">&#160;</td>

    <td style="border-bottom: Black 2.5pt double; text-align: left">$</td><td style="border-bottom: Black 2.5pt double; text-align: right"><span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensation_pp0d_c20250101__20250630_zuOKMv7twCXj" title="Stock-based compensation expense">20,974</span></td><td style="padding-bottom: 2.5pt; text-align: left">&#160;</td></tr>
  </table>


<p id="xdx_8A3_zPNIFykesJL5" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Stock compensation is included in general and
administrative expense in the Company&#8217;s condensed consolidated statements of and comprehensive income (loss).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company has a Long-Term Incentive Plan
that sets aside 5% of net proceeds from a liquidity event to be paid to the Company&#8217;s employees.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
